name: inputs/switch
title: Switch
description: An on/off setting that applies at once.

files.content:
export { Switch } from './Switch';
export type { SwitchProps } from './Switch';

keyboard.action: Move focus to and from the switch.

notes: Follows the WAI-ARIA switch pattern: a `button` with `role="switch"` and `aria-checked`, named by its visible label through `aria-labelledby`.
Clicking the label toggles the switch, like a native checkbox label.
The visible track is 28 px tall; an invisible extension gives it a 44 px target.
The on state shows a tick inside the thumb and a solid track; colour is not the only signal.
accessibility.reducedMotion: The thumb jumps to its new side instead of gliding.
